Greensill Capital was a London-based supply chain finance company founded by Lex Greensill, which provided working capital and receivables financing to companies and packaged the loans for investors, notably through Credit Suisse funds. It collapsed into insolvency in March 2021 after losing its insurance cover, with heavy exposure to Sanjeev Gupta's GFG Alliance, which led to political scrutiny in the UK. Recorded funding is about 1.7 billion dollars. It no longer operates. Notorious finance brand with no sponsorship potential.

Inmarsat was a London-based mobile satellite communications operator, providing maritime, aviation, government and enterprise connectivity with its geostationary satellite fleet (Global Xpress). It was taken private by Apax, Warburg Pincus, CPP Investments and the Ontario Teachers' pension plan in 2019, and acquired by Viasat in a deal completed in 2023. Customers were shipping lines, airlines, governments and corporate clients. B2B brand known in the maritime and aviation sectors, with no consumer awareness.

JSW JFE Kalinga is an Indian steel company that, according to Crunchbase, is jointly owned by JSW and JFE Steel interests. The headquarters location is unreadable in the data. Recorded funding is about 157.5 billion in an unreadable currency, probably Indian rupees. Its plants, products and scale are not confirmed here. Likely a B2B steel producer with no consumer profile, although JSW is a recognised Indian brand in sport. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

LifePoint Health is a Brentwood, Tennessee hospital operator, with about 60 community hospitals and many outpatient and rehabilitation facilities in the US, mainly in smaller communities. It was acquired by Apollo Global Management funds in 2018 and merged with Kindred Healthcare's hospital business to form ScionHealth in 2021, while LifePoint Health continued as an operating brand. It earns patient service revenue. Privately held. Local hospital brand with community recognition.

Mehilainen is Finland's largest private healthcare provider, based in Helsinki, running clinics, hospitals, diagnostic and occupational health services, elderly care and mental health care in Finland, Estonia and Sweden. It has revenue of more than 1 billion euros and serves public sector customers, insurers, employers and private patients. It is privately held and owned by private equity investors. Recorded funding is about 2 billion euros. Strong healthcare consumer brand in Finland.

Nutex Health is a Houston-based healthcare services company that owns and operates micro-hospitals and freestanding emergency rooms in Texas and several other states, together with a population health management arm and an independent physician association network. Revenue comes from patient services and value-based care contracts, and is around 500 million dollars. It is listed on Nasdaq (NUTX). Recorded funding is about 2.4 billion dollars. Regional healthcare brand with local patient awareness.

Ofo was a Beijing-based dockless bike-sharing company, founded in 2014 by students at Peking University, which put yellow bikes in cities across China and abroad in dozens of countries and raised over 2 billion dollars, from Alibaba, Didi, Softbank and others. It ran into financial difficulties in 2018, and later accumulated unpaid debts, and its operations have almost entirely stopped. Once a hugely visible consumer brand with global awareness, now defunct in practice.

Ramsay Sante is a French private hospital and primary care group, headquartered in Paris, formed from the former Generale de Sante. It operates about 350 hospitals and clinics in France, Italy, Sweden, Denmark and Norway, and is majority owned by Australia's Ramsay Health Care, with Predica (Credit Agricole Assurances) as a significant shareholder. Revenue is above 5 billion euros. Large healthcare brand in Europe, with regional patient awareness.

RoboStrategy is described in Crunchbase as a publicly traded fund, based in San Juan, Puerto Rico, which gives investors exposure to robotics, funding and technology holdings. Recorded funding is about 2.1 billion dollars, a figure that may reflect the platform's size or an error. Its holdings, management and listing venue are not confirmed here. Financial and technology brand with no consumer awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Rocket Internet is a Berlin-based internet company builder and investor, founded in 2007 by the Samwer brothers, which launched and funded online businesses including Zalando, HelloFresh, Delivery Hero, Jumia, Westwing and Global Fashion Group. It earned returns from stakes in portfolio companies. Listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (RKET) from 2014, it was taken private by Global Founders and Luxor in 2020. Raised about 2.2 billion dollars. Known in the tech and startup community.

SolarCity was a San Mateo, California residential solar installation and financing company, founded in 2006 by Lyndon and Peter Rive with Elon Musk as chairman and major investor. It installed rooftop solar systems for homeowners on lease or power-purchase agreements, and was the largest US residential solar provider. It listed on Nasdaq (SCTY) and was acquired by Tesla in 2016 for about 2.6 billion dollars, becoming Tesla Energy. Well-known solar brand in its time, no longer independent.

Trident Royalties plc is a London-based mining royalty and streaming company, listed on the AIM market, which acquires royalties over operating and development mines in commodities including gold, copper, lithium and iron ore, across Africa, Australia, Europe and the Americas. Revenue comes from production-linked payments. Recorded funding is about 2.3 billion dollars as shown, which may be inflated. Small investor-focused brand with no consumer awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Advanz Pharma is a specialty pharmaceutical company with its headquarters in London, focused on hospital medicines and rare disease, with a portfolio of off-patent and biosimilar products sold in Europe, plus Mississauga operations in Canada. It was taken private by Nordic Capital in 2021 after a Canadian listing. Customers are hospitals, pharmacies and health systems. Revenue is above 1 billion euros. B2B healthcare brand with no consumer awareness.

Aledade is a Bethesda, Maryland healthcare company that helps independent primary care practices join accountable care organisations and succeed in value-based care, giving them technology, analytics and operational support. It works with thousands of physicians across about 40 US states, earning shared savings and management fees from Medicare and other payers. It was founded in 2014 by Farzad Mostashari and has raised about 1.2 billion dollars. Privately held. B2B healthcare brand known in the medical community.

Altrad Group is a Montpellier-based international industrial services group, founded by Mohed Altrad, providing scaffolding, insulation, painting and industrial maintenance services for energy, oil and gas, nuclear and infrastructure, plus manufacturing of equipment such as concrete mixers. It operates in about 100 countries, with revenue of around 5 billion euros after acquiring Hertel and Cape. It is privately held. Known for owning rugby club Montpellier Herault Rugby and for sports sponsorship, including cycling.

Ardent Health Services is a Nashville-based hospital operator, running about 30 acute care hospitals and hundreds of outpatient sites across several US states, including Texas, Oklahoma, New Mexico, Idaho, Kansas and New Jersey, with its employed physician groups. Revenue is more than 6 billion dollars. It listed on the NYSE (ARDT) in 2024, with Equity Group Investments as the largest holder. Customers are patients and health plans. Regional healthcare brand with local visibility.

Armis is a San Francisco cybersecurity company that provides asset visibility, cyber exposure management and security for connected devices across IT, medical, industrial and cloud environments, using AI to find and protect unmanaged assets. Customers are large enterprises, hospitals and governments. Founded in 2015, it has raised about 1.3 billion dollars and has been valued at several billion dollars. Privately held. B2B security brand with limited consumer awareness, but a growing profile among corporate buyers.

Auramet is a Teaneck, New Jersey merchant bank that specialises in physical precious metals, trading, financing, refining and hedging for miners, refiners, jewellery makers, recyclers and industrial customers. It earns trading margins and financing fees, with offices in New York, London, Dubai and elsewhere. Founded in 2010, it is privately held. Recorded funding is about 1.3 billion dollars, probably credit facilities. B2B financial brand with no consumer awareness.

Australia Pacific LNG (APLNG) is a Brisbane-based Queensland gas company that produces coal seam gas in the Surat and Bowen basins and exports liquefied natural gas from Curtis Island to Asian buyers, including Sinopec and Kansai Electric, and supplies the domestic market. Its shareholders are Origin Energy (27.5 percent, and operator), ConocoPhillips (47.5 percent) and Sinopec (25 percent). Revenue is billions of dollars. B2B energy brand with no consumer awareness.

Boldyn Networks is a London-based neutral host network infrastructure company, formerly BAI Communications, which builds and runs shared 5G, in-building and small cell wireless, WiFi and fibre networks for transport systems, stadiums, universities, venues and cities. Customers include mobile operators and transit agencies, such as the New York City Subway and the London Underground. Funding is about 1.2 billion dollars. B2B infrastructure brand with little consumer awareness, though its networks serve large venues and stadiums.

British Columbia Ferry Services Inc. (BC Ferries) is a Victoria-based ferry operator, owned by the Province of British Columbia, running one of the world's largest ferry fleets on 25 routes with about 35 vessels along Canada's west coast, connecting Vancouver, Vancouver Island, the Gulf Islands and northern coastal communities. It carries about 20 million passengers a year, earning fares, retail and onboard revenue. Highly recognised in British Columbia and an icon for tourists and locals.

Comstock Resources is a Frisco, Texas natural gas producer, listed on the NYSE (CRK), focused on the Haynesville and Bossier shale in Louisiana and East Texas, with some Western Haynesville developments. Customers are gas buyers and LNG marketers. Revenue is above 1.5 billion dollars. Jerry Jones, owner of the Dallas Cowboys, is the majority shareholder. B2B energy brand with little consumer awareness, though its owner has a very high sports profile.

Endeavour Mining is a London-based gold producer with mines in West Africa, including Ity, Houndé, Mana, Sabodala-Massawa and Lafigué in Cote d'Ivoire, Burkina Faso, Senegal, and has operated several mines with annual output above 1 million ounces. It sells gold into the international bullion market, with revenue above 3 billion dollars. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange (EDV) and Toronto Stock Exchange, and has sponsored local events and football in Africa. B2B mining brand with minimal general consumer awareness.

EnergySource is a San Diego, California developer, constructor, operator and owner of geothermal power plants, notably in the Salton Sea region of Imperial Valley, supplying baseload renewable electricity to utilities, and exploring lithium extraction from geothermal brine. Recorded funding is about 1.36 billion dollars, possibly including project finance. Customers are utilities and energy buyers. Privately held. B2B energy brand with no consumer awareness. Exact ownership and scale are not fully confirmed here.
